tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Connects the user's Spotify account via OAuth. Opens a browser on this machine for approval and stores tokens locally. Use when other tools report you are not authenticated, or to switch accounts.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Plays music by free-text query (searches and starts the best match) or by Spotify URI. Handles "play some Radiohead", "play the album Kind of Blue", "play my Discover Weekly". Reports what it picked — relay that to the user so they can correct it.

query.description: What to play, e.g. "Bill Evans" or "Kind of Blue". Required unless uri is given.

type.description: What the query refers to (default: track)

uri.description: Spotify URI to play directly, e.g. from a previous search result

device_id.description: Target device id (see the devices tool)

tools.name: playback
tools.description: Transport controls for the active playback: pause, resume, next, previous, seek (value = seconds), volume (value = 0-100), shuffle (value = on/off), repeat (value = off/context/track).

value.description: seek: seconds · volume: 0-100 · shuffle: on/off · repeat: off/context/track

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: Current track, artist, album, progress, device, and shuffle/repeat state.

tools.name: queue
tools.description: action=add queues a track by query or URI; action=list shows what's playing and up next.

tools.name: devices
tools.description: action=list shows available Spotify devices; action=transfer moves playback to a device by name or id.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the Spotify catalog. Use when the user wants options to choose from; for a direct 'play X' request, prefer the play tool. Results include URIs usable with play, queue, playlists, and library. Max 10 results per type (API limit).

tools.name: get_playlists
tools.description: Lists the user's playlists with item counts and URIs.

tools.name: get_playlist_items
tools.description: Lists the tracks in one of the user's own or collaborative playlists (Spotify no longer exposes other users' playlist contents). Accepts a playlist id, URI, or URL.

playlist.description: Playlist id, spotify:playlist:… URI, or open.spotify.com URL

tools.name: modify_playlist
tools.description: action=create makes a new playlist (private by default); action=add_items appends track URIs to an existing playlist. Does not delete or remove anything.

public.description: Make the new playlist public (default false)

tools.name: library
tools.description: Saves, removes, or checks items in the user's Spotify library ('liked'). Works with any content URI: tracks, albums, artists (follow), shows, episodes. To save the current song, get its URI from now_playing first.
